# Story Package: Jesus & the Children (Mark 10:13-16)

**Story Key**: `jesusChildren`

**Position in 365 Roadmap**: Core “little ones” story.

---

## Bible Story Retelling

Mothers and fathers brought their little children to Jesus so He could bless them. The disciples said, “Do not trouble the Master.” But Jesus was not pleased. He said, “Let the little children come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.” He took them in His arms, put His hands on them, and blessed them.

(Mark 10:13-16)

---

## Coloring Page Prompt

Create one simple black-and-white line-art coloring page for ages 3–8. Clean bold outlines, large open spaces. Joyful scene: Jesus kneeling gently with open arms, smiling as several little children run to Him. Soft hills and flowers. Focus on the heart moment of Jesus welcoming the children. Peaceful, loving, reverent.
